claim: When a check fails on a task and also fails on master, the Hub neither passes nor blames the task but holds the approval for the operator (the PREEXISTING_CHECKS hold).

citations.quote:
When a check fails on a task and the same check also fails on master, the Hub neither passes nor
blames the task.

It **holds the approval for the operator** (`hub/hub/requirement_gate.py:1057`,
the PREEXISTING_CHECKS hold).
